snippet.title: Dream City Fugitive Version 1.84 (16 Minutes Gameplay)
snippet.description:
Dream City Fugitive is an open world combat focused urban role playing game. You're a fugitive on the run. Join a vigilante group to investigate horrible experiments and dealing with gang warfare on a small island, Dream City. Otherwise, pursue the path of a cult in their vision of dark salvation.

The game can be purchased on Play Store or itch.io website:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.com.inspiregamesnexus.dreamcitylivingfull
https://edykajang.itch.io/dream-city-fugitive
